name: ai-agents-terminal
description: Launch installed AI CLI agents from a status-bar launcher (opens in a terminal)

aiAgentsTerminal.yoloMode.description: YOLO mode: launch agents with auto-approve flags so they run without permission prompts.

aiAgentsTerminal.resumeMode.description: Resume mode: launch agents with their resume flag (from agents.json) to continue the most recent session.

aiAgentsTerminal.agents.description: User overrides / additions merged on top of the built-in catalog in agents.json. Override a built-in by matching its `command` (only the fields you set replace it); set `enabled: false` to hide a built-in; use a `command` not in agents.json to add a custom agent. Reload the window after editing.

command.description: CLI binary launched in the terminal (also used for PATH detection). Required.

displayName.description: Name shown in the launcher. Defaults to `command` for custom agents.

baseArgs.description: Arguments passed before the agent's subcommand.

yoloArgs.description: Extra args appended when YOLO (auto-approve) mode is on.

iconFile.description: Icon filename under the extension's media/agents folder (e.g. claude.png). If omitted, a default terminal icon is used.

enabled.description: Set to false to hide an agent without deleting its entry.

aiAgentsTerminal.installedAgents.description: Internal cache of AI agent commands detected on PATH. Maintained automatically — do not edit by hand. (internal)
